entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `GetUserNameFromPasswd` errors instead of returning empty string if `/etc/passwd` is missing #119216
  • No way to determine if you have data to read on SSLStream #119214
  • [cDAC] Run runtime-diagnostics pipeline on more platforms #119212
  • [API Proposal]: Add some LINQ extension to return a single element but not throw for multiple #119209
  • [wasm][AOT] error : Could not allocate XXX bytes #119205
    11.0.0
  • [API Proposal]: Expose API for escaping command-line arguments #119200
    Future
  • dotnet.exe v10.0.0-preview.7 x64 frequently hangs on `build` command under Windows ARM64 #119199
    10.0.0

Closed

  • Error: [MONO] * Assertion at /__w/1/s/src/mono/mono/metadata/assembly.c:1673, condition `<disabled>' not met #107730
  • Parameter is always short, but sometimes it's not passed correctly #119211
  • GCStress=3 has gotten very slow on osx-arm64 #114581
    10.0.0
  • JIT: Exception thrown only with runtime async #119061
    10.0.0
  • Cycle detection bypassed when using factory registration (AddSingleton(Func<IServiceProvider, T>)) #119198
  • When I added a TargetOS type to the build script, some BCL libraries failed to compile #117327
